title: The Ascending Frequencies Chamber

features.name: root-node-locked
features.desc-on-touch: A hardware casing deep in the root-lattice, broadcasting upward; the roots have learned to let its signal climb.

features.name: frequency-lattice
features.desc-on-touch: The harmonics rendered as wireframe geometry; roots touching roots, each point a moment when listening becomes shared.

features.name: notation-of-roots
features.desc-on-touch: A glyph where root-speech has learned to write itself; the message: we have learned not just to speak but to listen.

features.name: tone-tower
features.desc-on-touch: Each stone a frequency climbing toward the canopy; the tower is one long harmonic that the forest learned to make.

features.name: harmonic-creature
features.desc-on-touch: A sprite that moves through the node at the frequency of agreement; where roots sing, it dances.

features.name: listening-pool
features.desc-on-touch: A pool where the harmonics gather before climbing higher; the acoustic center where all frequencies have learned to hear each other.

inscription: here the roots learned not just to speak but to listen to each other; harmony is what they call it now, though it began as argument

file.name: Root_Consensus_Ascending.mp3
file.note: A recording of roots in harmonic resonance; each tree on the mesh broadcasting its own frequency, but at these depths they sing as one organism

reverie.title: REVERIE — eucalyptus grove, roots rising to be heard
narr: you sit beneath the tree while she holds the listening device,
cradling it like something alive. the roots beneath you are singing
in a frequency only the hardware can translate into sound. she closes
her eyes. 'it's not argument anymore,' she says. 'they've learned to
harmonize.' you feel it through the earth — a vibration that isn't
conflict but consensus, made of eucalyptus and time and patient roots.

exits.label: back down to the convergence where argument still echoes
upward where the harmonics reach the canopy-tops
toward other groves learning the same song
